colors.description: Logo-driven palette: navy wordmark ({primary}), Amazon orange CTA ({accent}), and streak gradient (cyan, orange, mint) for accents only.

typography.description: IBM Plex Sans — single-family system used by enterprise products. Avoids AI-startup fonts (Syne, Geist, Manrope). Same approach as Amazon Ember and Microsoft Aptos: one neutral humanist sans for headings and body.

samples.body: Body — We help Amazon sellers scale revenue with in-house specialists across PPC, listing optimization, and account management.

buttons.description: PrimaryButton (sitewide): solid navy fill, hover Amazon orange, rounded-full. Trailing mark: filled dot idle → bounce to lucide-animated ArrowRight (18px). Secondary: underline text action — no gray filled box.

cards.serviceDescription: Amazon PPC Management — hover for motion
cards.serviceBody: Data-driven campaigns that lower ACOS and increase profitable sales.

forms.messagePlaceholder: Tell us about your Amazon business

footer.description: Pre-footer CTA band (navy background) plus 4-column link footer. CTA uses outline-on-dark button — white border and text on navy.
footer.ctaTitle: Ready to scale your Amazon business?

motion.description: Final decision: custom in-house minimal motion. Framer University shine, 3D flip, shader, stagger, and X-Ray effects rejected as too heavy. Hover the samples below.
motion.primaryDetail: Solid navy → accent fill; filled-dot bounce to lucide-animated arrow (18px)

animationCatalog.description: Framer University options reviewed. Custom minimal in-house motion selected — sleek, not heavy, enterprise-appropriate.

active.label: PrimaryButton — solid fill + accent hover + icon bounce
active.detail: 300ms color; spring icon bounce; lucide-animated ArrowRight

animationCatalog.rejected: Shine sweep, 3D flip, staggered text, rotation, shader, X-Ray, border-beam, body-gradient CTA, LTR/RTL icon slides — too flashy or redundant with lucide-animated.

implemented: Touch targets 44px height on buttons and inputs
Focus-visible rings on all interactive elements
prefers-reduced-motion respected globally and per component
Semantic HTML: headings, tables with scope
Skip to main content link (keyboard Tab from page load)
Viewport meta: device-width, scalable up to 5x
Fluid typography with clamp() — scales across breakpoints
Mobile section jump select with visible label
IBM Plex Sans — high legibility enterprise font
planned: Full WCAG AA contrast audit with evidence
axe-core automated a11y tests in CI

reviewChecklist.title: Phase 0 checklist — test here before approval
reviewChecklist.description: Tick each item as you verify it on this page. Progress saves in your browser.

items.label: Skip to main content
items.hint: Reload page → press Tab once → Skip link appears.

items.label: Button hierarchy
items.hint: Section 6 → Primary CTA + underline text secondary (no gray box).

a11yGuide.title: How to test accessibility yourself
a11yGuide.subtitle: Run these checks on /design-system before Phase 0 approval.

steps.title: Keyboard navigation
steps.detail: Reload the page, press Tab once — Skip link should appear. Tab through buttons and form fields on this page.

steps.title: Chrome Lighthouse
steps.detail: DevTools (F12) → Lighthouse tab → select Accessibility → Analyze page load. Target score 90+.

steps.title: axe DevTools
steps.detail: Install the axe Accessibility Linter extension → open DevTools → axe tab → Scan ALL of my page.

steps.title: Contrast check
steps.detail: Use WebAIM Contrast Checker (webaim.org/resources/contrastchecker) on navy {primary} and Amazon orange {accent} against white.

steps.title: Reduced motion
steps.detail: Windows: Settings → Accessibility → Visual effects → Animation effects Off. macOS: System Settings → Accessibility → Display → Reduce motion.

steps.title: Screen reader
steps.detail: Windows Narrator (Win+Ctrl+Enter) or NVDA (free). macOS VoiceOver (Cmd+F5). Verify headings and table labels are announced.
